response.overview: A trans-continental cold water surfing odyssey capturing the raw spirit, glorious landscapes and pure perfection that arises when conditions align creating moments of cold water nirvana that rival any across the globe. Inspired by the storytelling style of classic ocean-fairing novels, the film follows a group of surfers as they explore the landscapes and waves off the North Atlantic fringes, from the Canadian Maritimes, north to Iceland and beyond to the wave rich coast of Ireland.
response.title: Perilous Sea
